title: Local-memory large-table rho with finite Fourier collision bound

claims.statement: For the full protected fixed-G1 pairing inversion problem,the concrete algorithm in proof.md has success at least0.4 under the sole disclosed heuristic that its fully charged,domain-separated SHA-256 computations behave as random functions for uniform challenges. collision-proof.md gives a finite idealized probability proof,without an assumed mean-collision bound. Deterministic total cold classical work,including all preprocessing,SHA computations,failed trials,pairings,output and verification,is at most2^(269/2) dense-Fp12 reference equivalents at fixed C=20000. Peak storage<2^30 bytes,preprocessing below2^(269/2) equivalents is included,and advice is zero. Every access is within ordinary local64-bit memory. This is an exploratory heuristic production-success claim,not an unconditional fixed-SHA theorem or a practical execution.

experiments.purpose: Check the65536-adding recurrence,Floyd recovery,invariant and first-repeat relation in tiny prime-field subgroups,and exact public production probability/accounting inequalities. Toy audit dictionary is not in production;does not certify fixed-SHA idealization or instruction counts.
